recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not restore ClaimResponse.insurer or ClaimResponse.requestor to 1..1 under FHIR-19463; any future mandatory insurer/requestor change should be made through a new explicit Financial Management work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-19463 requested ClaimResponse use, patient, insurer, and requestor cardinalities be fixed to 1..1; it was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification, with additional cardinality changes added during the work-group call.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly naming FHIR-19463 was found. Published R4/R4B profile JSON and the post-rework source lineage show the modified application: ClaimResponse.use, ClaimResponse.patient, ClaimResponse.created, ClaimResponse.insurer, and ClaimResponse.outcome were 1..1 while ClaimResponse.requestor remained 0..1.
additional_context: FHIR-22486 later relaxed too-tight Claim-family cardinalities for lightweight reference/summary use and was applied by HL7/fhir#2149 / f952b5321de9cdbcb7b2521862890c757e21d530, changing ClaimResponse.insurer from 1..1 to 0..1 before R5 publication. FHIR-37906 later removed provider/requester comment text implying 1..1 cardinality, and FHIR-43309 renamed ClaimResponse.patient to ClaimResponse.subject while preserving 1..1.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active ClaimResponse source has use 1..1, subject 1..1, created 1..1, outcome 1..1, insurer 0..1, and requestor 0..1, which is correct after considering the modified seed application and later published decisions.

related_jiras.note: Later Published R5 Claim-family cardinality decision relaxed mandatory provider/priority/insurance-style fields and was applied to ClaimResponse.insurer. Already represented on the combined branch by commit 1c9cc9d042fb6cdfb5ac212c5af83fc940ee7bfc.

Later Published R5 issue removed provider/requester comment wording that implied ClaimResponse.requestor and sibling fields were typically 1..1. Already represented on the combined branch by commit 6fea5e7a9a74dd587056c89bea8103e47a5b5282.
Later R6 work renamed ClaimResponse.patient to ClaimResponse.subject while retaining the required 1..1 cardinality.
